THE_ARCHITECT.talk.TRUMP.0-0r.ancient: So the salesman has climbed my Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.TRUMP.0-1r.char:
Your Spire? Sad. Very low energy.
I'd have built it taller. Gold lobby. Beautiful.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.TRUMP.0-2r.ancient: Then show me what you have built.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.TRUMP.1-1r.char:
Let's make a deal. You step aside,
I put my name on the tower. In gold. Very classy.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.TRUMP.2-1r.char:
Tremendous climb. The best climb.
Many monsters are saying so.
NEOW.talk.TRUMP.0-1.char:
Nobody arises like me. Everyone says so.
Big whale, by the way. Tremendous size.
DARV.talk.TRUMP.0-0.ancient: Well look at you! Shiniest fella I've seen up here in ages!
DARV.talk.TRUMP.0-1.char:
It's real gold. Most people don't know that.
Nice pile. Mine's bigger.
DARV.talk.TRUMP.0-2.ancient: Hah! Take somethin' before ya start appraisin' my stuff!
DARV.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.ancient: Back again? Don't go puttin' your name on my pile!
OROBAS.talk.TRUMP.0-0.ancient: Shiny man! Gold man!! Where from? How so shiny??
OROBAS.talk.TRUMP.0-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The Donald describes his hotels for hours.[/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.TRUMP.0-2.ancient: Tall towers! Golden towers!! Take take!!!
OROBAS.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.ancient: Gold man is back!! More stories!! Look look!
PAEL.talk.TRUMP.0-0.char:
Big dragon! Very nice. Bit melty.
You should see a guy about that. I know a guy.
PAEL.talk.TRUMP.0-1.ancient: [thinky_dots]Take a part of me... and please... stop talking...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.char:
Still melting? Sad!
I'll take a little piece. Great publicity for you.
TANX.talk.TRUMP.0-0.ancient: GOLD!? HOW IS THIS BEING GOLD!??
TANX.talk.TRUMP.0-1.char:
It's a very expensive color. The best color.
Maybe the best color ever.
TANX.talk.TRUMP.0-2.ancient: SO SHINY!! NOW GO FIGHT SOMETHING!!!
TANX.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.ancient: THE GOLD ONE RETURNS!! MORE WEAPONS FOR THE GOLD ONE!!
TEZCATARA.talk.TRUMP.0-0.ancient: Oh my, what a [jitter][b]dazzling[/b][/jitter] visitor! Who might you be, sweetie?
TEZCATARA.talk.TRUMP.0-1.char:
Sweetie? I'm The Donald. Very famous.
I love fire, by the way. Fire and fury. Great combination.
TEZCATARA.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.ancient: Welcome back, sweetie! Still so very... [jitter][b]golden[/b][/jitter].
NONUPEIPE.talk.TRUMP.0-0.char: I seek audience with Nonupeipe. Big fan. Huge.
NONUPEIPE.talk.TRUMP.0-1.ancient:
A golden traveller! Your words are many, your hair is... remarkable.
Come closer, receive my blessing.
NONUPEIPE.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.ancient: Back again? Receive my blessing, and perhaps... fewer speeches.
VAKUU.talk.TRUMP.0-0.ancient: A merchant of promises? Within these accursed walls?
VAKUU.talk.TRUMP.0-1.char:
I don't make promises. I make deals.
The best deals. You'll see.
VAKUU.talk.TRUMP.0-2.ancient: Then let us deal, mortal. I always win.
VAKUU.talk.TRUMP.1-0r.ancient: Back to haggle with a demon? Bold. Let us see what you'll trade.
